Top 10 officers efficiency score, 0–100

Speed vs. damage each dot is an officer · lower-left is better

Officer efficiency ranking

How the score works: 40% same-day attendance (visit date equals fire date), 40% small average area burnt per fire (fire contained early), 20% number of fires handled. Each part is ranked against the other officers in the current filters, so 100 means best on every measure. Visit gaps below 0 or above 30 days are treated as data-entry errors and left out of response time.
